purpose: Determine whether the rolling hot-path pair result contains an activation effect after separating low absolute turnover, industry, and signal-date float-market-cap exposure.

period.semantics: The primary rule must equal the rule selected using only earlier years in every rolling evaluation year. Discovery-period estimates are in-sample descriptions; 2019-2025 estimates are chronological rolling audits, not an untouched final holdout.

contrasts.name: pair_total
contrasts.role: Total pair effect after neutralizing industry and size; it still contains the low-amount coordinate.

contrasts.name: activation_increment
contrasts.role: Primary test of whether activation adds return inside the same low-amount quintile.

contrasts.name: activation_vs_less_active
contrasts.role: Monotone-direction diagnostic against lower activation bins only.

contrasts.name: activation_vs_neighbor
contrasts.role: Local diagnostic against the adjacent activation quintile.

contrasts.name: low_amount_increment
contrasts.role: Separates the low absolute turnover coordinate from the activation coordinate.

neutralization.estimator: date-equal coarsened exact-matching ATT; stratum control means are weighted by treatment counts

analysis.short_horizon_diagnostic: Report D5 activation information separately from the D20 activation gate and from any profit claim.
analysis.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg over contrast D20-return tests within each period and match specification
analysis.activation_gate: primary matched D20-return HAC lower bound above zero, at least five positive rolling years, and primary outcome-match coverage at least 70%
